name: Beginner DSA Roadmap
description: A guided path for engineers new to data structures and algorithms. Focus on fundamentals and building intuition with easy problems before touching advanced topics.
milestones: Arrays and strings basics — prefix sums, two pointers.
Hash tables — membership checks, frequency counting.
Sorting fundamentals — understand merge sort and quick sort.
Stacks and queues — parentheses and monotonic stacks.
Basic tree traversal — inorder, preorder, postorder, level-order.
recommended_problems: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
study_plan: Week 1-2: arrays, strings, hash tables (10-15 easy problems).
Week 3: sorting and binary search (8-10 problems).
Week 6: trees (8-10 problems) and review your solved set.
tips: Spend 20-30 minutes thinking before peeking at solutions.
Re-solve problems after a few days to cement intuition.
